tips: Natural affinity makes a discipline easier to learn. Starting studies determine which magic and introductory spells you already know.
Creating or substantially redesigning a spell uses Spellcraft. Casting a learned spell uses its magical discipline.
Your First Spell can be a tiny practical invention. Start with one useful effect and a safe test.
You can study magic outside your affinities. A good teacher, practice and a useful book can all help.
Simple spell experiments can be brief. Difficult inventions may need research, materials and several attempts.
Force and Finesse support martial styles. You do not need to be a spellcaster to become an adventurer.
Demanding techniques use Stamina; spells use Mana. Ordinary movement and basic attacks remain useful.
A staff, wand or grimoire helps control learned magic. Owning one does not teach every spell.
Morning academy classes follow your issued timetable. Check it when you are unsure where to go.
Every academy teaches Magic Theory, but its other courses and professors differ.
The Crucible is an optional place to seek combat, not a compulsory school appointment.
Guild membership begins with its licensure exam. A badge determines which guild jobs you can accept.
A posted guild reward is the amount you earn for completing the agreed work.
Portal permission comes from the Great Sage’s Court. A guild badge is not a portal key.
The Evertree Base is Glowhaven’s portal hub. A return crossing brings you to its Portal Room.
A portal key remains an actual carried item. Check your inventory before planning a crossing.
Drakenspire is known for exceptional spellblade weapons, mountain resources and its sacred dragons.
Asterveil is wilderness with dangerous wildlife. Preparation, company and a retreat route matter.
Wraith Island lies offshore; its prison admits authorized visitors and workers as well as inmates.
A prisoner can ask to serve the remainder quietly and skip uneventful time.
Guards can demand surrender. A demand is not the same thing as a completed arrest.
Health, Mana, Stamina, Renown and Infamy describe different parts of your character’s current situation.
Public reputation and a particular person’s affection are different. Fame does not make every stranger a friend.
Meeting someone does not recruit them. Companions have their own work, loyalties and reasons to stay.
An NPC knows what they have actually learned. A private conversation is not a reason for them to reveal every secret.
A familiar bond connects people; it does not grant ownership or automatic obedience.
Beastfolk usually have mostly human features. Your selected ears, horns, tail or feathers make the individual.
Fae bodies vary widely. A very short fae can be a fully grown adult.
Portrait style, camera and backdrop choices are optional and do not change your map position or equipment.
Shopping starts with a quote. Browsing or asking a price does not purchase an item.
A useful piece of ordinary equipment can matter as much as a spectacular spell.
You can ask the narrator for a reminder of an agreed task, a timetable or your current options.
